# Mobile wallet

A personal finance app drawn for a phone: a vivid gradient balance card with the largest type of the theme,
round quick actions, a spending summary, transactions grouped by day and a bottom tab bar, in a device-like
column on wide screens that fills the width on narrow ones. Sending money opens a sheet with a contact row,
a keypad of its own and a confirmation that loads; a transaction opens its details; the tabs switch to the
card with its controls and limit, a donut of spending, and the profile. Every custom color, radius and size
is a token, so it follows the color mode, the accent color and the density.

**Level**: Scenarios · **Components used**: [Avatar](../components/Avatar.md), [Button](../components/Button.md), [CopyButton](../components/CopyButton.md), [Descriptions](../components/Descriptions.md), [DonutChart](../components/DonutChart.md), [Heading](../components/Heading.md), [Icon](../components/Icon.md), [IconButton](../components/IconButton.md), [Inline](../components/Inline.md), [Input](../components/Input.md), [LinkButton](../components/LinkButton.md), [ListItem](../components/ListItem.md), [Modal](../components/Modal.md), [Panel](../components/Panel.md), [Pill](../components/Pill.md), [Progress](../components/Progress.md), [Segmented](../components/Segmented.md), [SegmentedBar](../components/SegmentedBar.md), [SettingRow](../components/SettingRow.md), [Stack](../components/Stack.md), [Switch](../components/Switch.md), [Text](../components/Text.md), [useMessage](../components/useMessage.md)

```tsx
import { type ReactNode, useState } from 'react'
import {
  Avatar,
  Button,
  CopyButton,
  Descriptions,
  DonutChart,
  Heading,
  Icon,
  IconButton,
  type IconName,
  Inline,
  Input,
  LinkButton,
  ListItem,
  Modal,
  Panel,
  Pill,
  Progress,
  Segmented,
  SegmentedBar,
  SettingRow,
  Stack,
  Switch,
  Text,
  useMessage,
} from 'vellum-ui'
import styles from './MobileWallet.module.css'

const USER = { name: 'Alex Morgan', email: 'alex.morgan@example.com' }

const CARD = { last4: '4821', expires: '09/29', holder: 'ALEX MORGAN' }

type Tone = 1 | 2 | 3 | 4 | 5 | 6 | 7

type Category = 'groceries' | 'dining' | 'transport' | 'shopping' | 'bills' | 'income' | 'transfer'

const CATEGORIES: Record<
  Category,
  { readonly label: string; readonly icon: IconName; readonly tone: Tone }
> = {
  groceries: { label: 'Groceries', icon: 'receipt', tone: 3 },
  dining: { label: 'Dining', icon: 'smile', tone: 2 },
  transport: { label: 'Transport', icon: 'truck', tone: 1 },
  shopping: { label: 'Shopping', icon: 'package', tone: 5 },
  bills: { label: 'Bills', icon: 'zap', tone: 4 },
  income: { label: 'Income', icon: 'briefcase', tone: 6 },
  transfer: { label: 'Transfer', icon: 'send', tone: 7 },
}

interface Transaction {
  readonly id: string
  readonly merchant: string
  readonly category: Category
  /** Negative for money spent, positive for money received. */
  readonly amount: number
  readonly day: string
  readonly time: string
  readonly note?: string
}

const TRANSACTIONS: readonly Transaction[] = [
  {
    id: 'TX-8F2K-1043',
    merchant: 'Blue Bottle Coffee',
    category: 'dining',
    amount: -6.5,
    day: 'Today',
    time: '08:42',
  },
  {
    id: 'TX-8F2K-1042',
    merchant: 'Riley Chen',
    category: 'transfer',
    amount: 45,
    day: 'Today',
    time: '07:15',
    note: 'Dinner split',
  },
  {
    id: 'TX-8F2J-0991',
    merchant: 'Whole Foods',
    category: 'groceries',
    amount: -84.32,
    day: 'Yesterday',
    time: '18:20',
  },
  {
    id: 'TX-8F2J-0987',
    merchant: 'Acme Inc.',
    category: 'income',
    amount: 3200,
    day: 'Yesterday',
    time: '09:00',
  },
  {
    id: 'TX-8F2J-0975',
    merchant: 'Metro card',
    category: 'transport',
    amount: -25,
    day: 'Yesterday',
    time: '08:05',
  },
  {
    id: 'TX-8F2G-0930',
    merchant: 'City Power',
    category: 'bills',
    amount: -96.4,
    day: 'Mon, Nov 10',
    time: '12:00',
  },
  {
    id: 'TX-8F2G-0921',
    merchant: 'Paper & Ink',
    category: 'shopping',
    amount: -32.99,
    day: 'Mon, Nov 10',
    time: '10:31',
  },
]

type Period = 'week' | 'month'

const SPENDING: Record<Period, Partial<Record<Category, number>>> = {
  week: { shopping: 120, groceries: 86.4, dining: 64.2, transport: 38 },
  month: { groceries: 412.8, shopping: 389.9, dining: 268.5, bills: 214, transport: 146 },
}

const CONTACTS = ['Riley Chen', 'Sam Lee', 'Jordan Park', 'Taylor Kim', 'Morgan Diaz'] as const

type Tab = 'home' | 'cards' | 'stats' | 'profile'

const TABS: readonly { readonly key: Tab; readonly label: string; readonly icon: IconName }[] = [
  { key: 'home', label: 'Home', icon: 'home' },
  { key: 'cards', label: 'Cards', icon: 'wallet' },
  { key: 'stats', label: 'Stats', icon: 'chart' },
  { key: 'profile', label: 'Profile', icon: 'user' },
]

const usd = new Intl.NumberFormat('en-US', { style: 'currency', currency: 'USD' })

const signed = (n: number) => (n > 0 ? `+${usd.format(n)}` : usd.format(n))

const wait = (ms: number) => new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, ms))

function spendingItems(period: Period) {
  return Object.entries(SPENDING[period])
    .map(([key, value]) => ({ key, value: value ?? 0, category: CATEGORIES[key as Category] }))
    .sort((a, b) => b.value - a.value)
    .map(({ key, value, category }) => ({ key, name: category.label, value, slot: category.tone }))
}

function byDay(list: readonly Transaction[]) {
  const groups = new Map<string, Transaction[]>()
  for (const t of list) groups.set(t.day, [...(groups.get(t.day) ?? []), t])
  return [...groups]
}

function Chip(props: { readonly category: Category; readonly large?: boolean }) {
  const c = CATEGORIES[props.category]
  return (
    <span className={styles.chip} data-tone={c.tone} data-large={props.large || undefined}>
      <Icon name={c.icon} size={props.large ? 24 : 18} />
    </span>
  )
}

function BigAmount(props: { readonly value: number; readonly hidden?: boolean }) {
  if (props.hidden) return <span className={styles.bigAmount}>$ ••••••</span>
  const [whole, cents] = usd.format(props.value).split('.')
  return (
    <span className={styles.bigAmount}>
      {whole}
      <span className={styles.cents}>.{cents}</span>
    </span>
  )
}

function TransactionRow(props: { readonly t: Transaction; readonly onOpen: () => void }) {
  const { t } = props
  return (
    <button type="button" className={styles.txn} data-vl-state="" onClick={props.onOpen}>
      <Chip category={t.category} />
      <span className={styles.txnText}>
        <Text weight="semibold" truncate>
          {t.merchant}
        </Text>
        <Text size="sm" tone="secondary" truncate>
          {t.note ?? CATEGORIES[t.category].label} · {t.time}
        </Text>
      </span>
      <Text weight="semibold" numeric tone={t.amount > 0 ? 'success' : 'primary'}>
        {signed(t.amount)}
      </Text>
    </button>
  )
}

function View(props: {
  readonly title: ReactNode
  readonly action?: ReactNode
  readonly children: ReactNode
}) {
  return (
    <div className={styles.view}>
      <Inline justify="between">
        <Heading level={2}>{props.title}</Heading>
        {props.action}
      </Inline>
      {props.children}
    </div>
  )
}

const KEYS = ['1', '2', '3', '4', '5', '6', '7', '8', '9', '.', '0', 'back'] as const

function SendSheet(props: {
  readonly balance: number
  readonly onSent: (to: string, amount: number, note: string) => void
  readonly onDone: () => void
}) {
  const [to, setTo] = useState<string>(CONTACTS[0])
  const [digits, setDigits] = useState('0')
  const [note, setNote] = useState('')
  const [sending, setSending] = useState(false)
  const [sent, setSent] = useState<number | null>(null)
  const amount = Number(digits)

  // A keypad of our own: at most two decimals and six whole digits, like a banking app
  const press = (key: (typeof KEYS)[number]) => {
    if (key === 'back') return setDigits((d) => (d.length > 1 ? d.slice(0, -1) : '0'))
    setDigits((d) => {
      if (key === '.') return d.includes('.') ? d : `${d}.`
      const [whole = '', cents] = d.split('.')
      if (cents !== undefined ? cents.length >= 2 : whole.length >= 6) return d
      return d === '0' ? key : d + key
    })
  }

  const send = async () => {
    setSending(true)
    await wait(1200) // The transfer request of your API
    props.onSent(to, amount, note)
    setSending(false)
    setSent(amount)
  }

  if (sent !== null)
    return (
      <div className={styles.success}>
        <span className={styles.successMark}>
          <Icon name="check" size={32} />
        </span>
        <Stack gap={1} align="center">
          <Heading level={2}>Money sent</Heading>
          <Text tone="secondary">
            {usd.format(sent)} is on its way to {to}.
          </Text>
        </Stack>
        <Button variant="primary" size="lg" block onClick={props.onDone}>
          Done
        </Button>
      </div>
    )

  const reason =
    amount <= 0 ? 'Enter an amount' : amount > props.balance ? 'More than your balance' : undefined

  return (
    <Stack gap={4}>
      {/* Contacts: a scrolling row of avatars; the chosen one gets the accent ring */}
      <fieldset className={styles.contacts} aria-label="Recipient">
        {CONTACTS.map((name) => (
          <button
            key={name}
            type="button"
            className={styles.contact}
            data-vl-state=""
            aria-pressed={name === to}
            onClick={() => setTo(name)}
          >
            <Avatar name={name} size={48} ring={name === to} />
            <Text size="xs" weight={name === to ? 'semibold' : 'regular'} truncate>
              {name.split(' ')[0]}
            </Text>
          </button>
        ))}
      </fieldset>

      <Stack gap={1} align="center">
        <output className={styles.entry} aria-live="polite" aria-label="Amount">
          <span className={styles.entryCurrency}>$</span>
          {digits}
        </output>
        <Text size="sm" tone={amount > props.balance ? 'danger' : 'secondary'} numeric>
          {amount > props.balance
            ? 'More than your balance'
            : `Balance ${usd.format(props.balance)}`}
        </Text>
      </Stack>

      <div className={styles.keypad}>
        {KEYS.map((key) => (
          <button
            key={key}
            type="button"
            className={styles.key}
            data-vl-state=""
            aria-label={
              key === 'back' ? 'Delete last digit' : key === '.' ? 'Decimal point' : undefined
            }
            onClick={() => press(key)}
          >
            {key === 'back' ? <Icon name="arrow-left" size={20} /> : key}
          </button>
        ))}
      </div>

      <Input
        prefix={<Icon name="edit" />}
        placeholder="Add a note (optional)"
        aria-label="Note"
        maxLength={60}
        value={note}
        onChange={(e) => setNote(e.target.value)}
      />
      <Button
        variant="primary"
        size="lg"
        block
        icon="send"
        loading={sending}
        disabled={reason !== undefined}
        disabledReason={reason}
        onClick={send}
      >
        Send {amount > 0 ? usd.format(amount) : ''} to {to.split(' ')[0]}
      </Button>
    </Stack>
  )
}

export function MobileWallet() {
  const message = useMessage()
  const [tab, setTab] = useState<Tab>('home')
  const [balance, setBalance] = useState(4825.6)
  const [hidden, setHidden] = useState(false)
  const [period, setPeriod] = useState<Period>('month')
  const [transactions, setTransactions] = useState(TRANSACTIONS)
  // The Modal stays rendered: `open` switches, the last transaction stays shown while it closes
  const [detail, setDetail] = useState<Transaction>()
  const [detailOpen, setDetailOpen] = useState(false)
  const [sendOpen, setSendOpen] = useState(false)
  const [frozen, setFrozen] = useState(false)
  const [freezing, setFreezing] = useState(false)

  const spending = spendingItems(period)
  const spent = spending.reduce((sum, s) => sum + s.value, 0)

  const openDetail = (t: Transaction) => {
    setDetail(t)
    setDetailOpen(true)
  }

  const onSent = (to: string, amount: number, note: string) => {
    setBalance((b) => b - amount)
    setTransactions((list) => [
      {
        id: `TX-${Date.now().toString(36).toUpperCase()}`,
        merchant: to,
        category: 'transfer',
        amount: -amount,
        day: 'Today',
        time: 'Just now',
        note: note || undefined,
      },
      ...list,
    ])
    message.success(`Sent ${usd.format(amount)} to ${to}`)
  }

  const toggleFreeze = async (next: boolean) => {
    setFreezing(true)
    await wait(800) // The card API
    setFreezing(false)
    setFrozen(next)
    message.success(next ? 'Card frozen: payments are declined' : 'Card unfrozen')
  }

  const later = (what: string) => message.info(`${what} opens here`)

  const quickActions: readonly { label: string; icon: IconName; run: () => void }[] = [
    { label: 'Send', icon: 'send', run: () => setSendOpen(true) },
    { label: 'Request', icon: 'arrow-down', run: () => later('Request money') },
    { label: 'Top up', icon: 'plus', run: () => later('Top up') },
    { label: 'More', icon: 'more', run: () => later('More actions') },
  ]

  const periodSwitch = (
    <Segmented
      size="sm"
      value={period}
      onChange={setPeriod}
      options={[
        { label: 'Week', value: 'week' },
        { label: 'Month', value: 'month' },
      ]}
    />
  )

  const card = (
    <div className={styles.card} data-frozen={frozen || undefined}>
      <Inline justify="between">
        <span className={styles.cardBrand}>vellum</span>
        {frozen ? <Icon name="lock" size={20} label="Frozen" /> : <Icon name="zap" size={20} />}
      </Inline>
      <span className={styles.cardNumber}>•••• •••• •••• {hidden ? '••••' : CARD.last4}</span>
      <Inline justify="between">
        <span className={styles.cardLabel}>{CARD.holder}</span>
        <span className={styles.cardLabel}>{CARD.expires}</span>
      </Inline>
    </div>
  )

  const views: Record<Tab, ReactNode> = {
    home: (
      <div className={styles.view}>
        <header className={styles.top}>
          <Avatar name={USER.name} size={44} ring />
          <span className={styles.hello}>
            <Text size="sm" tone="secondary">
              Good morning
            </Text>
            <Text size="lg" weight="semibold">
              {USER.name.split(' ')[0]}
            </Text>
          </span>
          <span className={styles.bell}>
            <IconButton
              icon="bell"
              variant="soft"
              size="lg"
              label="Notifications, 2 new"
              onClick={() => later('Notifications')}
            />
            <span className={styles.bellDot} aria-hidden />
          </span>
        </header>

        {/* The balance card: our own surface, a gradient of the accent and two chart colors */}
        <section className={styles.balance} aria-label="Balance">
          <Inline justify="between">
            <span className={styles.balanceLabel}>Total balance</span>
            <button
              type="button"
              className={styles.eye}
              data-vl-state=""
              aria-pressed={hidden}
              aria-label={hidden ? 'Show amounts' : 'Hide amounts'}
              onClick={() => setHidden((h) => !h)}
            >
              <Icon name={hidden ? 'eye-off' : 'eye'} size={18} />
            </button>
          </Inline>
          <BigAmount value={balance} hidden={hidden} />
          <Inline justify="between">
            <span className={styles.cardDigits}>•••• {CARD.last4}</span>
            <span className={styles.trend}>
              <Icon name="arrow-up" size={14} />
              2.4% this month
            </span>
          </Inline>
        </section>

        <nav className={styles.actions} aria-label="Quick actions">
          {quickActions.map((a, i) => (
            <button
              key={a.label}
              type="button"
              className={styles.action}
              data-primary={i === 0 || undefined}
              data-vl-state=""
              onClick={a.run}
            >
              <span className={styles.actionIcon}>
                <Icon name={a.icon} size={22} />
              </span>
              <Text size="sm" weight="medium">
                {a.label}
              </Text>
            </button>
          ))}
        </nav>

        <Panel title="Spending" actions={periodSwitch}>
          <Stack gap={3}>
            <Inline align="baseline" gap={2}>
              <Text size="xl" weight="semibold" numeric>
                {usd.format(spent)}
              </Text>
              <Text size="sm" tone="secondary">
                {period === 'week' ? 'this week' : 'in November'}
              </Text>
            </Inline>
            <SegmentedBar
              variant="tall"
              label="Spending by category"
              items={spending}
              format={usd.format}
            />
          </Stack>
        </Panel>

        <Stack gap={3}>
          <Inline justify="between">
            <Heading level={3}>Activity</Heading>
            <LinkButton onClick={() => later('All transactions')}>See all</LinkButton>
          </Inline>
          {byDay(transactions).map(([day, list]) => (
            <div key={day} className={styles.day}>
              <Inline justify="between">
                <Text overline>{day}</Text>
                <Text size="sm" tone="tertiary" numeric>
                  {signed(list.reduce((sum, t) => sum + t.amount, 0))}
                </Text>
              </Inline>
              <div className={styles.dayList}>
                {list.map((t) => (
                  <TransactionRow key={t.id} t={t} onOpen={() => openDetail(t)} />
                ))}
              </div>
            </div>
          ))}
        </Stack>
      </div>
    ),

    cards: (
      <View
        title="Cards"
        action={
          <IconButton
            icon="plus"
            variant="soft"
            label="Add a card"
            onClick={() => later('Add a card')}
          />
        }
      >
        {card}
        <Panel title="Card settings">
          <Stack gap={2}>
            <SettingRow
              title="Freeze card"
              description="Declines every payment until you unfreeze it."
              control={<Switch checked={frozen} loading={freezing} onChange={toggleFreeze} />}
            />
            <SettingRow
              title="Online payments"
              control={<Switch defaultChecked disabled={frozen} />}
            />
            <SettingRow title="Contactless" control={<Switch defaultChecked disabled={frozen} />} />
          </Stack>
        </Panel>
        <Panel title="Monthly limit">
          <Stack gap={2}>
            <Inline justify="between">
              <Text weight="semibold" numeric>
                {usd.format(spent)}
              </Text>
              <Text size="sm" tone="secondary" numeric>
                of {usd.format(2000)}
              </Text>
            </Inline>
            <Progress
              percent={(spent / 2000) * 100}
              tone={spent > 1600 ? 'warning' : 'accent'}
              showValue={false}
              aria-label="Monthly limit used"
            />
          </Stack>
        </Panel>
      </View>
    ),

    stats: (
      <View title="Stats" action={periodSwitch}>
        <Panel>
          <DonutChart
            plain
            title="Spending by category"
            description={period === 'week' ? 'This week' : 'November'}
            data={spending}
            format={usd.format}
            height={200}
          />
        </Panel>
        <div className={styles.dayList}>
          {spending.map((s) => {
            return (
              <div key={s.key} className={styles.txn}>
                <Chip category={s.key as Category} />
                <span className={styles.txnText}>
                  <Text weight="semibold">{s.name}</Text>
                  <Text size="sm" tone="secondary" numeric>
                    {Math.round((s.value / spent) * 100)}% of spending
                  </Text>
                </span>
                <Text weight="semibold" numeric>
                  {usd.format(s.value)}
                </Text>
              </div>
            )
          })}
        </div>
      </View>
    ),

    profile: (
      <View title="Profile">
        <div className={styles.profile}>
          <Avatar name={USER.name} size={72} ring />
          <Stack gap={0} align="center">
            <Text size="xl" weight="semibold">
              {USER.name}
            </Text>
            <Text size="sm" tone="secondary">
              {USER.email}
            </Text>
          </Stack>
          <Pill tone="success" icon="shield">
            Verified
          </Pill>
        </div>
        <Panel flush>
          <Stack gap={1} padding={2}>
            <ListItem
              leading={<Icon name="user" />}
              title="Personal details"
              onClick={() => later('Personal details')}
            />
            <ListItem
              leading={<Icon name="lock" />}
              title="Security"
              description="Passcode and Face ID"
              onClick={() => later('Security')}
            />
            <ListItem
              leading={<Icon name="bell" />}
              title="Notifications"
              onClick={() => later('Notifications')}
            />
            <ListItem
              leading={<Icon name="logout" />}
              title="Sign out"
              onClick={() => later('Sign out')}
            />
          </Stack>
        </Panel>
      </View>
    ),
  }

  return (
    // The stage centers the phone; the phone is the device-like column, its screen scrolls under the tab bar
    <div className={styles.stage}>
      <div className={styles.phone}>
        <div className={styles.statusBar} aria-hidden>
          <span>9:41</span>
          <span className={styles.island} />
          <span>5G</span>
        </div>
        {/* The key restarts the entrance motion of the view on every tab change */}
        <main key={tab} className={styles.screen}>
          {views[tab]}
        </main>
        <nav className={styles.tabbar} aria-label="Main">
          {TABS.map((t) => (
            <button
              key={t.key}
              type="button"
              className={styles.tab}
              data-vl-state=""
              aria-current={t.key === tab ? 'page' : undefined}
              onClick={() => setTab(t.key)}
            >
              <span className={styles.tabIcon}>
                <Icon name={t.icon} size={20} />
              </span>
              {t.label}
            </button>
          ))}
        </nav>
      </div>

      <Modal
        open={detailOpen}
        title="Transaction"
        width="var(--vl-page-width-form)"
        onCancel={() => setDetailOpen(false)}
        footer={
          <Button block onClick={() => later('Report a problem')} icon="alert">
            Report a problem
          </Button>
        }
      >
        {detail && (
          <Stack gap={4}>
            <Stack gap={2} align="center">
              <Chip category={detail.category} large />
              <Text weight="semibold">{detail.merchant}</Text>
              <span className={styles.detailAmount} data-income={detail.amount > 0 || undefined}>
                {signed(detail.amount)}
              </span>
              <Pill tone="success" dot>
                Completed
              </Pill>
            </Stack>
            <Descriptions column={1} size="sm">
              <Descriptions.Item label="Date">
                {detail.day}, {detail.time}
              </Descriptions.Item>
              <Descriptions.Item label="Category">
                {CATEGORIES[detail.category].label}
              </Descriptions.Item>
              {detail.note && <Descriptions.Item label="Note">{detail.note}</Descriptions.Item>}
              <Descriptions.Item label="Card">
                <Text mono>•••• {CARD.last4}</Text>
              </Descriptions.Item>
              <Descriptions.Item label="Reference">
                <Inline gap={1}>
                  <Text mono>{detail.id}</Text>
                  <CopyButton text={detail.id} size="sm" label="Copy reference" />
                </Inline>
              </Descriptions.Item>
            </Descriptions>
          </Stack>
        )}
      </Modal>

      <Modal
        open={sendOpen}
        title="Send money"
        width="var(--vl-page-width-form)"
        footer={null}
        maskClosable={false}
        onCancel={() => setSendOpen(false)}
      >
        <SendSheet balance={balance} onSent={onSent} onDone={() => setSendOpen(false)} />
      </Modal>
    </div>
  )
}
```

```css
/*
 * Mobile wallet: a phone app with a bold, rounded look. Every value is a token (var(--vl-...)), a calc() of
 * tokens, a relative unit or 0 / 1px, so the screen follows the color mode, the accent color and the density.
 * Hover, press and focus come from the shared state layer (data-vl-state); ::before is left to the library.
 *
 * Tints mix a token into another with color-mix(in oklab, ...): neutral tokens carry no real hue, and oklch
 * would pull the mix towards a hue of 0 (pink).
 */

/* The stage fills the space it is given and centers the phone; it is the container the queries below measure */
.stage {
  container: stage / inline-size;
  display: flex;
  flex: 1;
  justify-content: center;
  min-height: 0;
  /* Names of our own, reused below: the radius of the rounded surfaces and the size of the round targets */
  --wallet-radius: calc(var(--vl-radius-2xl) + var(--vl-space-1));
  --wallet-target: calc(var(--vl-control-height-lg) + var(--vl-space-3));
}

/*
 * The device: a phone-wide column with a bezel, the radius of a phone and the shadow of a dialog. The bezel is
 * the fixed dark primitive on purpose, a device looks dark in both modes. Its height follows the stage, and
 * stops at roughly the proportions of a phone.
 */
.phone {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  width: min(100%, calc(var(--vl-page-width-form) + var(--vl-space-6)));
  max-height: calc(var(--vl-page-width-form) * 2.1);
  overflow: hidden;
  border-radius: calc(var(--vl-radius-2xl) * 2.4);
  background:
    radial-gradient(
      120% 40% at 50% 0%,
      color-mix(in oklab, var(--vl-color-accent) 12%, transparent),
      transparent 70%
    ),
    var(--vl-color-bg-canvas);
  box-shadow:
    0 0 0 calc(var(--vl-space-2) + 1px) var(--vl-neutral-900),
    0 0 0 calc(var(--vl-space-2) + var(--vl-space-1)) var(--vl-color-border-strong),
    var(--vl-shadow-pop);
  margin-block: var(--vl-space-2);
}

/* The status bar of the device, with the camera island in the middle */
.statusBar {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 1fr auto 1fr;
  align-items: center;
  padding: var(--vl-space-3) var(--vl-space-6) var(--vl-space-1);
  color: var(--vl-color-text-primary);
  font-size: var(--vl-font-size-sm);
  font-weight: var(--vl-font-weight-semibold);
  font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
}

.statusBar > :last-child {
  justify-self: end;
}

.island {
  width: calc(var(--vl-space-8) * 1.5);
  height: calc(var(--vl-space-5) + var(--vl-space-1));
  border-radius: var(--vl-radius-full);
  background: var(--vl-neutral-950);
}

/* On a narrow screen the app is the screen: no bezel, no status bar, the full width */
@container stage (width < 34em) {
  .phone {
    max-height: none;
    border-radius: var(--wallet-radius);
    box-shadow: none;
    margin-block: 0;
  }

  .statusBar {
    display: none;
  }
}

/* The screen scrolls; the tab bar stays at the bottom of the phone */
.screen {
  flex: 1;
  min-height: 0;
  overflow-y: auto;
  scrollbar-width: thin;
  padding: var(--vl-space-3) var(--vl-space-4) var(--vl-space-5);
}

/* A view: a column with the generous gaps of a touch screen, rising in when the tab changes */
.view {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: var(--vl-space-5);
  /* biome-ignore lint/correctness/noUnknownFunction: global() references keyframes outside the CSS Module */
  animation: global(vl-rise) var(--vl-motion-duration-slow) var(--vl-motion-ease-standard) both;
}

/* One tone per element, chosen with data-tone and read as --tone, instead of an inline style */
.stage [data-tone="1"] {
  --tone: var(--vl-color-chart-1);
}
.stage [data-tone="2"] {
  --tone: var(--vl-color-chart-2);
}
.stage [data-tone="3"] {
  --tone: var(--vl-color-chart-3);
}
.stage [data-tone="4"] {
  --tone: var(--vl-color-chart-4);
}
.stage [data-tone="5"] {
  --tone: var(--vl-color-chart-5);
}
.stage [data-tone="6"] {
  --tone: var(--vl-color-chart-6);
}
.stage [data-tone="7"] {
  --tone: var(--vl-color-chart-7);
}

/* —— Home —— */

.top {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: var(--vl-space-3);
}

.hello {
  display: flex;
  flex: 1;
  flex-direction: column;
  min-width: 0;
  line-height: var(--vl-line-height-heading);
}

/* An unread dot over the bell, ringed in the canvas color so it reads as cut out of the button */
.bell {
  position: relative;
  display: inline-flex;
}

.bellDot {
  position: absolute;
  inset-block-start: var(--vl-space-2);
  inset-inline-end: var(--vl-space-2);
  width: var(--vl-space-2);
  height: var(--vl-space-2);
  border-radius: var(--vl-radius-full);
  background: var(--vl-color-danger);
  box-shadow: 0 0 0 calc(var(--vl-space-1) / 2) var(--vl-color-bg-canvas);
  pointer-events: none;
}

/*
 * The balance card: the solid accent of primary buttons (made for white text in both modes), moving towards
 * the violet of the chart palette, with a glow of the pink one in the top corner and a coloured shadow below.
 */
.balance {
  position: relative;
  isolation: isolate;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: var(--vl-space-4);
  overflow: hidden;
  padding: var(--vl-space-5);
  border-radius: calc(var(--wallet-radius) + var(--vl-space-1));
  background:
    radial-gradient(
      circle at 105% -10%,
      color-mix(in oklab, var(--vl-color-chart-5) 75%, transparent),
      transparent 55%
    ),
    linear-gradient(
      140deg,
      var(--vl-color-accent-fill),
      color-mix(in oklab, var(--vl-color-accent-fill) 35%, var(--vl-color-chart-7))
    );
  box-shadow: 0 var(--vl-space-3) var(--vl-space-6) calc(var(--vl-space-4) * -1)
    color-mix(in oklab, var(--vl-color-accent-fill) 70%, transparent);
  color: var(--vl-color-text-on-accent);
}

/* Two thin rings of light, the playful decoration of the card; ::after because ::before is the library's */
.balance::after,
.card::after {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  z-index: -1;
  inset-block-end: -60%;
  inset-inline-end: -25%;
  width: 85%;
  aspect-ratio: 1;
  border-radius: var(--vl-radius-full);
  border: calc(var(--vl-space-4) + var(--vl-space-1)) solid
    color-mix(in oklab, var(--vl-color-text-on-accent) 9%, transparent);
  box-shadow: 0 0 0 var(--vl-space-6)
    color-mix(in oklab, var(--vl-color-text-on-accent) 5%, transparent);
}

.balanceLabel {
  font-size: var(--vl-font-size-sm);
  font-weight: var(--vl-font-weight-medium);
  opacity: 0.85;
}

/* The largest type of the theme, with tabular figures so the number does not jump while it changes */
.bigAmount {
  font-family: var(--vl-font-family-heading);
  font-size: var(--vl-font-size-4xl);
  font-weight: var(--vl-font-weight-semibold);
  font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
  line-height: 1;
  letter-spacing: calc(var(--vl-letter-spacing-heading) * 2);
}

.cents {
  font-size: var(--vl-font-size-2xl);
  opacity: 0.7;
}

/* The round button on the card: a frosted circle; the state layer takes the white of its text */
.eye {
  display: grid;
  place-items: center;
  width: var(--vl-control-height-md);
  height: var(--vl-control-height-md);
  padding: 0;
  border: 0;
  border-radius: var(--vl-radius-full);
  background: color-mix(in oklab, var(--vl-color-text-on-accent) 16%, transparent);
  color: inherit;
  cursor: pointer;
}

.cardDigits {
  font-family: var(--vl-font-family-mono);
  font-size: var(--vl-font-size-sm);
  letter-spacing: 0.1em;
  opacity: 0.85;
}

.trend {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: var(--vl-space-1);
  padding: var(--vl-space-1) var(--vl-space-2);
  border-radius: var(--vl-radius-full);
  background: color-mix(in oklab, var(--vl-color-text-on-accent) 18%, transparent);
  font-size: var(--vl-font-size-xs);
  font-weight: var(--vl-font-weight-semibold);
}

/* Quick actions: four round targets in a row, the first one solid */
.actions {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr);
  gap: var(--vl-space-2);
}

.action {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  align-items: center;
  gap: var(--vl-space-2);
  padding: var(--vl-space-2) 0;
  border: 0;
  border-radius: var(--vl-radius-xl);
  background: none;
  color: var(--vl-color-text-primary);
  font: inherit;
  cursor: pointer;
}

.actionIcon {
  display: grid;
  place-items: center;
  width: var(--wallet-target);
  height: var(--wallet-target);
  border-radius: var(--vl-radius-full);
  background: var(--vl-color-bg-surface);
  box-shadow:
    var(--vl-shadow-near),
    inset 0 0 0 1px var(--vl-color-border);
  color: var(--vl-color-accent-text);
}

.action[data-primary] .actionIcon {
  background: var(--vl-color-accent-fill);
  box-shadow: var(--vl-shadow-raised);
  color: var(--vl-color-text-on-accent);
}

/* —— Transactions —— */

.day {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: var(--vl-space-2);
}

/* A rounded group of rows on the surface, as on a phone settings screen */
.dayList {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  padding: var(--vl-space-1);
  border-radius: var(--wallet-radius);
  background: var(--vl-color-bg-surface);
  box-shadow: var(--vl-shadow-near);
}

.txn {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: var(--vl-space-3);
  min-width: 0;
  padding: var(--vl-space-2) var(--vl-space-3);
  border: 0;
  border-radius: calc(var(--wallet-radius) - var(--vl-space-1));
  background: none;
  color: var(--vl-color-text-primary);
  font: inherit;
  text-align: start;
}

button.txn {
  cursor: pointer;
}

.txnText {
  display: flex;
  flex: 1;
  flex-direction: column;
  min-width: 0;
}

/* A round chip: a wash of the tone, the icon in the tone moved towards the text color to stay readable */
.chip {
  display: grid;
  flex: none;
  place-items: center;
  width: var(--vl-control-height-lg);
  height: var(--vl-control-height-lg);
  border-radius: var(--vl-radius-full);
  background: color-mix(in oklab, var(--tone) 16%, transparent);
  color: color-mix(in oklab, var(--tone) 80%, var(--vl-color-text-primary));
}

.chip[data-large] {
  width: var(--wallet-target);
  height: var(--wallet-target);
}

.detailAmount {
  font-family: var(--vl-font-family-heading);
  font-size: var(--vl-font-size-3xl);
  font-weight: var(--vl-font-weight-semibold);
  font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
  line-height: var(--vl-line-height-heading);
}

.detailAmount[data-income] {
  color: var(--vl-color-success-text);
}

/* —— Cards —— */

/* The payment card: a credit-card ratio, the violet and pink of the chart palette */
.card {
  position: relative;
  isolation: isolate;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  justify-content: space-between;
  aspect-ratio: 1.586;
  overflow: hidden;
  padding: var(--vl-space-5);
  border-radius: var(--wallet-radius);
  background: linear-gradient(
    150deg,
    var(--vl-color-chart-7),
    color-mix(in oklab, var(--vl-color-chart-7) 40%, var(--vl-color-chart-5))
  );
  box-shadow: 0 var(--vl-space-3) var(--vl-space-6) calc(var(--vl-space-4) * -1)
    color-mix(in oklab, var(--vl-color-chart-7) 70%, transparent);
  color: var(--vl-color-text-on-accent);
  transition: filter var(--vl-motion-duration-base) var(--vl-motion-ease-standard);
}

/* Frozen: the card loses its color, which says "not usable" at a glance */
.card[data-frozen] {
  filter: grayscale(1) brightness(0.8);
}

.cardBrand {
  font-family: var(--vl-font-family-heading);
  font-size: var(--vl-font-size-xl);
  font-weight: var(--vl-font-weight-semibold);
  letter-spacing: calc(var(--vl-letter-spacing-heading) * 3);
}

.cardNumber {
  font-family: var(--vl-font-family-mono);
  font-size: var(--vl-font-size-lg);
  letter-spacing: 0.12em;
}

.cardLabel {
  font-family: var(--vl-font-family-mono);
  font-size: var(--vl-font-size-xs);
  letter-spacing: 0.08em;
  opacity: 0.85;
}

/* —— Profile —— */

.profile {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  align-items: center;
  gap: var(--vl-space-3);
  padding-block: var(--vl-space-2);
}

/* —— Bottom tab bar: frosted surface; the current tab gets an accent pill behind its icon —— */

.tabbar {
  position: sticky;
  bottom: 0;
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr);
  gap: var(--vl-space-1);
  padding: var(--vl-space-2) var(--vl-space-3) var(--vl-space-4);
  border-top: 1px solid var(--vl-color-border);
  background: color-mix(in oklab, var(--vl-color-bg-surface) 85%, transparent);
  backdrop-filter: blur(var(--vl-space-4));
}

.tab {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  align-items: center;
  gap: var(--vl-space-1);
  padding: var(--vl-space-1) 0;
  border: 0;
  border-radius: var(--vl-radius-xl);
  background: none;
  color: var(--vl-color-text-secondary);
  font: inherit;
  font-size: var(--vl-font-size-xs);
  font-weight: var(--vl-font-weight-medium);
  cursor: pointer;
}

.tabIcon {
  display: grid;
  place-items: center;
  width: calc(var(--vl-space-7) + var(--vl-space-2));
  height: var(--vl-space-6);
  border-radius: var(--vl-radius-full);
  transition: background-color var(--vl-motion-duration-base) var(--vl-motion-ease-standard);
}

.tab[aria-current="page"] {
  color: var(--vl-color-accent-text);
  font-weight: var(--vl-font-weight-semibold);
}

.tab[aria-current="page"] .tabIcon {
  background: var(--vl-color-accent-subtle);
}

/* —— Send sheet —— */

/* A row of contacts that scrolls sideways, with the edge of the next one peeking out */
.contacts {
  display: flex;
  gap: var(--vl-space-1);
  overflow-x: auto;
  scrollbar-width: none;
  /* A fieldset groups the choices for screen readers; its default frame is removed */
  min-width: 0;
  margin: 0 calc(var(--vl-space-2) * -1);
  padding: 0;
  border: 0;
}

.contact {
  display: flex;
  flex: none;
  flex-direction: column;
  align-items: center;
  gap: var(--vl-space-1);
  width: calc(var(--vl-space-8) + var(--vl-space-2));
  padding: var(--vl-space-2) var(--vl-space-1);
  border: 0;
  border-radius: var(--vl-radius-xl);
  background: none;
  color: var(--vl-color-text-primary);
  font: inherit;
  cursor: pointer;
}

/* The amount being typed, in the largest type, centered like a calculator display */
.entry {
  display: flex;
  align-items: flex-start;
  gap: var(--vl-space-1);
  font-family: var(--vl-font-family-heading);
  font-size: var(--vl-font-size-4xl);
  font-weight: var(--vl-font-weight-semibold);
  font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
  line-height: 1;
  letter-spacing: calc(var(--vl-letter-spacing-heading) * 2);
}

.entryCurrency {
  padding-block-start: var(--vl-space-1);
  color: var(--vl-color-text-tertiary);
  font-size: var(--vl-font-size-2xl);
}

/* The keypad: a 3 x 4 grid of large, soft keys */
.keypad {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
  gap: var(--vl-space-2);
}

.key {
  display: grid;
  place-items: center;
  height: calc(var(--vl-control-height-lg) + var(--vl-space-1));
  border: 0;
  border-radius: var(--vl-radius-full);
  background: var(--vl-color-fill);
  color: var(--vl-color-text-primary);
  font: inherit;
  font-size: var(--vl-font-size-xl);
  font-weight: var(--vl-font-weight-medium);
  font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
  cursor: pointer;
}

/* After sending: a large check in the success colors, then Done */
.success {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  align-items: center;
  gap: var(--vl-space-4);
  padding-block: var(--vl-space-5) var(--vl-space-2);
  text-align: center;
  /* biome-ignore lint/correctness/noUnknownFunction: global() references keyframes outside the CSS Module */
  animation: global(vl-rise) var(--vl-motion-duration-slow) var(--vl-motion-ease-standard) both;
}

.successMark {
  display: grid;
  place-items: center;
  width: calc(var(--wallet-target) * 1.4);
  height: calc(var(--wallet-target) * 1.4);
  border-radius: var(--vl-radius-full);
  background: var(--vl-color-success-subtle);
  color: var(--vl-color-success-text);
  box-shadow: 0 0 0 var(--vl-space-2) color-mix(in oklab, var(--vl-color-success) 10%, transparent);
}
```
